summary.zh: 补全类型注解并开启严格类型检查
summary.en: Add type hints, generics and strict mypy or pyright checks.

description.zh: 讲清类型注解、泛型和 Protocol 结构化接口的写法，帮 Python 项目逐步落地类型安全。给老代码补注解、设计通用类，或配置 mypy、pyright 的严格模式时使用。
description.en: Covers type hints, generics and Protocol-based interfaces so a Python project can adopt type safety step by step. Use it when adding annotations, designing generic classes or turning on strict mypy and pyright checks.
